threshold_policy: 0.5 fixed from Phase 1; never tuned on evaluation data

label_convention.note: ALL Phase-3 candidates are trained on CANONICAL labels (y=1 MACHINE, y=0 HUMAN): MAGE stored labels are complemented (stored-1==HUMAN). Calibrators are therefore fit in canonical space and p(machine)=calibrator(model(x)) directly - no complement at inference. The Phase-1 locked baseline keeps its stored-orientation semantics and is scored via the Phase-2 machinery (1 - calibrated stored score) ONLY as a reference.

splits.note: val_tune (model/hyperparameter selection) and val_cal (calibration) are group-disjoint halves of MAGE-validation, split exactly like Phase 1. val_cal is further split into cal_fit/cal_eval (group-disjoint) ONLY for comparing calibrator types in E4; the winning calibrator is refit on the full val_cal for the final artifact.

ablations.justification: PREREGISTERED before Phase-3 results: (a) rare_token_ratio/mean_log_df are document-frequency statistics of the MAGE training corpus and transfer poorly by construction; (b) TTR-family features are length/corpus-composition dependent (Phase-2 E7 drift: hapax_ratio Cohen-d -1.07 MAGE vs HC3 machine text); (c) boilerplate/transition/connective phrase rates are generator-vintage lexicons (Phase-2 E7: boilerplate_rate 0.10 MAGE machine vs 0.64 HC3 machine); (d) hash/bullet/header rates and uppercase_word_ratio are markdown/source formatting artifacts, not authorship evidence (Phase-2 hswag forensics showed formatting/length artifacts dominating errors).

lr.selection: val_tune PR-AUC (same grid as Phase 1 for comparability)
lr.pipeline: median impute -> standardize -> lbfgs, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=1000

extratrees.justification: the spec's variance-baseline family (Random Forest/ExtraTrees); extra-trees randomization reduces single-feature artifact memorization vs plain trees; native feature_importances_ for cross-checking permutation importance

include_if_all.note: mean ROC over {ood_gpt, ood_gpt_para, hc3, raid_clean} must beat hgb by >= 0.003

verdict_rule.note_rule: pre-declared: syntactic features enter the final model ONLY if they improve generalization without unacceptable calibration/FPR cost; otherwise documented and excluded

e4.note: calibrator types compared on group-disjoint cal_eval after fitting on cal_fit; winner refit on full val_cal for the artifact. Test metrics for both types are descriptive only (never used to pick).

selection_pool.challenger_rules: abl_minus_leakage_preregistered enters only if it was fitted (E1 always fits it); hgb_syn enters ONLY if the pre-declared E2 verdict rule passes. Ablations other than the preregistered leakage one are family-importance studies, never selection candidates.
selection_pool.note: ranked lexicographically by `selection.criteria_order`; the locked Phase-1 baseline is the incumbent to beat on the robustness criteria but is NEVER retrained and is scored through the Phase-2 machinery

lodo.selection_rule: top-2 candidates by the E5 robustness score (mean ROC over ood_gpt/ood_gpt_para/hc3/raid) - chosen BEFORE running LODO
lodo.use: supporting evidence: a robustness leader whose LODO mean PR-AUC is >0.02 below the runner-up's LODO mean PR-AUC triggers a documented manual override (swap) that is recorded in the selection trace

artifact_flag.note: flag feature if |val AUC - HC3 AUC| or |val AUC - RAID AUC| exceeds this while val AUC >= 0.60

edited_text.system: You are a careful editor. You always obey the user's instructions exactly and output only the requested text.
edited_text.note: same protocol as Phase-2 E3 so edited texts are comparable; regenerated once and cached (Phase-2 E3 did not persist the edited texts)

e8.decision_rule: smallest min_words whose EXCLUDED bucket on test has F1-macro strictly below the KEPT subset F1-macro (the cut must actually separate quality) AND abstained fraction <= abstain_frac_max; validated descriptively on HC3/OOD (kept-subset human FPR must not exceed full-set human FPR). Coverage constraint rationale: abstention must stay a minority of inputs so the tool remains useful.
e8.mixed_band_rule: p in [lo, hi] around 0.5 is 'mixed/low confidence' where [lo, hi] is the smallest reliability interval on val_cal containing 0.5 whose observed accuracy is < 0.75 (empirical; frozen before test reporting)

selection.robustness_score: mean ROC-AUC over {ood_gpt, ood_gpt_para, hc3, raid_clean} for EVERY candidate (identical components for all); LODO mean PR-AUC is reported as supporting evidence and applies only the pre-declared >0.02 override rule in e5.lodo.use
selection.note: lexicographic comparison with tie bands; every candidate's score per criterion is recorded so the decision can be audited. NOT selected by headline MAGE accuracy.

notes: Phase 3 config. MAGE-only training/validation; HC3 and RAID are evaluation-only (never trained/calibrated/tuned on). OOD sets are evaluation-only. Threshold 0.5 never tuned. Phase-1 baseline artifacts untouched (ml/models/baseline-v1).
